title: What's a fool-proof method of getting xDrip to communicate with my G5 sensor?
body:
Today, I have lost data for 123 minutes, while my Dex receiver is still receiving data.  I've done "Restart Sensor", and in desperation, "Forget Device".   still no data.   Normally i have data day and night, day after day.   What can I try next?

Using an S7 with xDrip dated 7/15/2018 which is very reliable, normally.
EDIT: Rebooted phone, but no joy.
